### Register to take this workshop in Madison!
UW-Madison has its own [local Carpentries community](https://datascience.wisc.edu/uw-madison-carpentries-community/) which teaches this workshop. To be notified of upcoming sessions, subscribe to the [Data Science @ UW Newsletter](https://datascience.wisc.edu/newsletter/).

### Alternatively, work through the materials independently!
The lesson is published as open educational material. Visit the [lesson materials](URL) to work through them on your own. UW-Madison researchers can get help at [Coding Meetup](https://datascience.wisc.edu/hub/#dropin).
